title: A Strawberry Database: Geometric Properties, Images and 3D Scans
notes: Dryad dataset page reports 1,611 individual strawberries, 22 controlled RGB views per fruit, manually measured width/height, and weights with and without calyx. Dryad terms publish datasets under CC0; the dataset page shows no alternate restriction. Before APPROVED: audit datasheet columns/units, prove image filename to fruit ID join, select the weight target consistent with Nongtori field Weight_g, and split strictly by fruit identity so the 22 views of one berry never cross train/validation/test. Controlled postharvest imagery is suitable for pretraining/geometry baselines, not field-domain acceptance.
